property_summary: The transfer function must return false or revert when any internal call fails; the buggy version always returns true even if a sub-call fails.
change_summary: Replace `{ (bool _s,) = caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], v)); require(_s); }` with `{ (bool _s,) = caddress.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], v)); }` (remove require(_s)) so that transfer returns true even when a sub-call fails.
